name: Brass Bandsman Arthur

intro.text: The colliery bands were the heart of this region. Brass, polish, and a conductor who counts in a voice you can hear through a wall. Four, three, two...

win: Magnificent! I have not been so thoroughly out-played since Gateshead.
after: A brass band is thirty people who all need to breathe at the same time. It's closer to a miracle than music.
